Merchant scope comes from verified identity, not a client field that happens to satisfy an FK.
Runtime role sebaiknya hanya dapat memak: Runtime roles should access only invariant-preserving writers and authorized reads, with separate migration roles. RLS can add a layer when roles, policies and connection context are designed correctly; superusers and BYPASSRLS bypass it, as owners usually do. Pools must safely set and clear context. This page creates no roles or policies and proves no tenant isolation.
Catat actor terverifikasi, merchant, cor: Record verified actor, merchant, correlation ID, policy-appropriate business key, decision, reason and time with restricted access and retention. Do not log secrets, tokens, signing credentials or full sensitive payloads for easier debugging. Redaction and structured formatting also prevent newlines from impersonating log events. The previous schema posting audit is only one marker; security audit needs separate access, integrity protection, monitoring and a procedure for logging failures.

Account for in-flight retries so rotation neither loses legitimate callbacks nor keeps old keys valid forever. Rate limits, timeouts and resource bounds reduce abuse but do not replace idempotency or authorization.
